test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held on: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The mean proportion between 7 and 112 is:
solution:
Given:

Mean proportional of 7 and 112

Formula used:

Mean proportional of p and q = √(pq)

Calculation:

Let the mean proportion of p and q be x.

⇒ x = √7 × 112

⇒ x = √784

⇒ x = 28

**The mean proportion between 7 and 112 is 28.**
